Description: Tony Dauer successfully opens the door and rescues Oswald, then talks with him. Oswald says he was trapped in the Kitchen and discusses ghosts and Martha Galley’s abnormal behavior. After the piano starts, Tony leaves.
Location: Kitchen（Kitchen）
Key Information:
  - Tony Dauer finds the key and successfully opens the door, freeing Oswald.
  - Oswald explains he was trapped in the Kitchen and says he did not see who locked the door.
  - Tony says he had been drinking in the room and suddenly saw a corpse appear before his eyes.
  - Oswald tells Tony that Martha Galley was here shortly before.
  - The piano starts, implying No. 5’s death. Tony decides to find the others, while Oswald goes to handle the Chapel.
  - Thunder sounds after Tony leaves, heightening the tension.
Characters:
  [Tony Dauer（Tony Dauer）] Person No. 4, rescues Oswald and discusses the predicament.
    · Rescues Oswald and discusses the strange situation in the house.
    · Warns Oswald not to trust others and decides to find the others.
    · Mentions his abnormal experience after drinking and prepares to address the crisis.
  [Oswald（Oswald）] Person No. 3, previously locked in the Kitchen, has many doubts about what’s happening.
    · Explains to Tony that he was trapped and did not see who locked the door.
    · Warns Tony not to trust others and suggests Martha Galley may already be controlled.
    · Says the house is full of ghosts and he doesn’t know how to stop the events.
